notes: Flags: none. Fit: living-room, in front of the KIVIK sofa ikea-39440593 in place of a hard coffee table: 35.375 x 27.5", 16.875" high, 14" to 18" from the sofa (F-39) · fits. Upholstered, no corners at a 4-year-old's head height, in the sofa's own cover: "Rest your feet on the footstool or use it as an extra seat or a comfortable extension of your sofa."; "The footstool has a generous storage space under the seat"; "The cover is easy to keep clean since it can be machine washed and is easy to take off and put on again." (Tibbleby, dope-dyed polyester, herringbone). Drinks need a tray or the side table.
